ownership.quote: This is why when the opportunity arose for us to join OpenAI, it was an easy yes, and I'm happy to announce today that we've entered into an agreement to join OpenAI as part of the Agent Infrastructure team.

stage.quote: We never raised outside capital. That let us stay patient, stay close to the problems, and put a great deal of care into the products we built.
stage.note: Bootstrapped from founding in 2017 until the company (Cirrus Labs, maker of Cirrus CI / Cirrus Runners / Tart) entered an agreement to join OpenAI's Agent Infrastructure team, announced 2026-04-07. No priced equity round was ever raised, so 'stage' reflects funding history; ownership is now effectively an OpenAI acquihire.

total_funding_usd.basis: Founder statement on the official company blog: no outside capital was ever raised.

note: Cirrus Labs was founded by Fedor Korotkov in 2017 and built Cirrus CI, Cirrus Runners (macOS/Linux GitHub Actions runner subscriptions, the product covered by this card), and the Tart/Vetu/Orchard virtualization tools; the company was self-funded throughout. On 2026-04-07 Cirrus Labs announced an agreement to join OpenAI's Agent Infrastructure team: Cirrus Runners stopped accepting new customers (existing customers served through their contract terms), Cirrus CI shut down effective 2026-06-01, and the open-source tools (Tart, Vetu, Orchard) were relicensed under a more permissive license with licensing fees dropped. The pricing page for Cirrus Runners remains live but is stale marketing for a discontinued product.
